title: A Good Librarian Like a Good Shepherd
synopsis:
The story is set at Shiomi Academy, a vast, prestigious academy with a Daitoshokan (literally, "great library") that rivals Japan's national library. As a member of the Library Club, Kyoutarou Kakei goes to Daitoshokan to enjoy reading by himself. He then meets a second-year girl named Tsugumi Shirasaki through the efforts of a so-called "shepherd" who fulfills people's wishes. Eventually, more girls join the club thanks to the "shepherd."

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Formation of the Library Club

episodes.synopsis: Kakei and the others start their Shiomi Happy Project activities by picking up trash and find a beautiful tuning fork...

episodes.synopsis: Kakei and Suzuki get help from the genius of the cafeteria while Shirasaki and the others pay the Song Princess a visit…

episodes.synopsis: The girls of the Library Club invite Kakei out on a group date, but Kodachi has Shepherd work for him even on his day off.

episodes.title: The Song Princess' Decision
episodes.synopsis: As the Library Club prepares for the festival, Misono thinks back on her life of singing and decides what she wants for the future.

episodes.title: Confession

episodes.title: A Good Librarian Like A Good Shepherd
